summary_1line: Ravana abducts many women from various realms; their collective curse foretells that a woman will cause his destruction, after which he consoles his widowed sister.

image_candidates.scene_text: The Pushpaka chariot flies through the sky crowded with weeping women as Ravana carries them away after slaying their kin.
The captive women raise their hands in grief and curse Ravana, while blossoms fall from the heavens and celestial gongs resound.
Ravana’s sister collapses before him in Lanka, tearful and furious, accusing him of killing her husband in battle.
